summary.text: Nancy Theriault is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 29 and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Theriault won a June 9, 2026 special election for District 29 and is a realtor, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Nancy Theriault's career experience includes working as a realtor, according to Ballotpedia.
She won the special general election for Maine House District 29 on June 9, 2026, defeating Nancy McDowell, and succeeded Kathy Javner.
McDowell is again her Democratic opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
